description: Two sine oscillators, A and B, each with ten harmonics, and a grid of buttons ring-modulating any harmonic of A against any of B; everything switched on is summed and divided by the number switched on

params.text: Adds that harmonic of oscillator A straight into the output
Adds that harmonic of oscillator B straight into the output
Adds the product of one harmonic of A and one harmonic of B into the output, which is a ring modulation of the two
Sets the base octave of that oscillator, five down to four up
Transposes that oscillator by up to 11 semitones either way

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of oscillator A, a volt per octave
Sets the pitch of oscillator B, a volt per octave

outputs.text: Everything switched on, added together and divided by the number of things switched on

notes: every button comes up off and the output is silent until at least one harmonic button or grid button is switched on

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
